title: The Rot That Thinks
text: A mound of fungus as tall as a man, pale and slick, pulsing slowly like a heart at rest. Threads of it run off into the dark in every direction. When anyone speaks, it pulses in time with the words, as if it is learning them.

options.label: The wisest leans close and studies it, hoping to learn what it is learning.

outcomes.text: It is a mind, of a kind. They learn how it changes the things it grows in, and wish they had not.
It learns them too. Something pale begins to grow under their nails, and it will not be cut away.
It gives them something it grew: a curio of living wood, still faintly warm.

options.label: Burn it, before it learns any more of your words.

outcomes.text: It does not scream, but every spore in the air tries to, and the sound gets into your heads.

options.label: Speak to it and bargain, since it seems so eager to listen.

outcomes.text: It wants a memory. It takes one, slowly, and pays in Essence that smells of earth. Nobody can recall what it took.
